description: QC-check one HLA typing (all loci) against the pinned release: resolves every reported allele, flags unresolvable/outdated/locus-mismatched/null alleles, flags too-many/single/homozygous per locus, computes the B-leader (-21 M/T) and KIR-ligand (C1/C2/Bw4) profile, and DRB3/4/5 expected-vs-reported. Nomenclature and internal-consistency checking of the report, not clinical interpretation. typing: {"A": ["A*01:01", "A*02:01"], "B": [...], "DRB1": [...], ...} (any nomenclature era, G/P group names, A*02:XX and two-field A*02:01g included; NMDP MAC codes are flagged, not expanded; allele strings only, no patient identifiers).

typing.description: locus -> up to 4 reported allele names. Allele strings only: never patient names, medical record numbers, dates of birth, or accession or case identifiers.

name: check_typing

drb345.description: DRB3/4/5 expected from DRB1 vs reported; null when DRB1 is not typed.

code.description: unresolvable, deprecated_name, locus_mismatch, null_allele, too_many_alleles, single_allele, homozygous, drb345_unexpected or drb345_not_reported.

severity.description: Any error makes the typing invalid.

g_group.description: G group; NONE, AMBIGUOUS or UNRESOLVABLE.

ligands.description: Class I (A/B/C) ligand facts, aggregated over member alleles: 'ambiguous' when members disagree, 'unknown' when no residue data.

ambiguities.description: For each ambiguous field, the distinct member values.

bw.description: Bw4 / Bw6 / non-Bw4 / unclassified / ambiguous / unknown / not_expressed; null for HLA-C.

c_group.description: C1 / C2 / unclassified / ambiguous / unknown; null when not applicable.

expressed.description: false when every member allele is null (not expressed).

kir_ligand.description: C1 / C2 / Bw4 / Bw4-80I / Bw4-80T / none / ambiguous / unknown.

leader_21.description: Residue at leader position -21 (M or T; another letter is possible), ambiguous, unknown or not_expressed.

residue_80.description: Residue at position 80 (amino-acid letter), ambiguous, unknown or not_expressed.

loci.description: Reported locus key -> one row per reported allele, in input order.

b_leader_genotype.description: HLA-B -21 leader genotype such as M/T ('?' unknown); null when B is not typed.

c_kir_ligand_genotype.description: HLA-C KIR ligand genotype such as C1/C2 ('none', '?'); null when C is not typed.

kir_ligand_status.description: complete only with two classified alleles at each of A, B and C.

kir_ligands_present.description: Sorted subset of C1, C2, Bw4, Bw4-80I, Bw4-80T.

release.description: IPD-IMGT/HLA release every verdict was computed against.

valid.description: true when there are no error-severity issues. Gate on this before using the typing.
